requires.n: Artifact Creature that is a Gnome and/or Artificer

2527-4073-4917-8095--75.notablePrerequisites:
Jan Jansen and the additional Gnome or Artificer do not have a +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one additional artifact creature.
2527-4073-4917-8095--75.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact creature you control except the Gnome or Artificer.
Jan Jansen triggers, causing it and creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Jan Jansen.
When Jan Jansen dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing the Gnome or Artificer.
When the Gnome or Artificer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Retribution of the Ancients by paying {B} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Jan Jansen and the other Gnome or Artificer, giving a creature -2/-2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6495-6972-7157.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Arcbound Lancer.
When Arcbound Lancer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Lancer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Lancer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6972-7157.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Gruul Turf from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Gruul Turf enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

874-1170-1329-7895.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-7895.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Delif's Cone.
Cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Little Bear.

Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.

Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat.

3010-3259-5223.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3010-3259-5223.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4661-4865.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4661-4865.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vesuvan Shapeshifter and Vesuvan Doppelganger each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vesuvan Doppelganger trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4661-4865.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1987-4477-6259.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-4477-6259.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4477-6259.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

206-222-527-2438.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
206-222-527-2438.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

950-1169-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

679-5014-6282.easyPrerequisites:
You have a card in your graveyard.
You have a way to lose life.
679-5014-6282.description:
Lose life by any method.
Lich's Mastery's second ability triggers, causing you to exile a card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to lose 1 life and draw a card.
Lich's Mastery second ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Putrid Imp by discarding a card.
Resolve the Lich's Mastery trigger, exiling a card from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 3.

671-2034-4593-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Daxos triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the creature tokens die, Daxos triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.
671-2034-4593-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Mistmoon Griffin.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Mistmoon Griffin.
When Mistmoon Griffin dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Mistmoon Griffin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Mistmoon Griffin trigger, failing to exile it as it is not in your graveyard and then returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

Put both Éomer tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Éomer tokens trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get two additional combat phases after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

77-413-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1069-1879-3552-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1879-3552-5499.description:
Activate Blaring Recruiter by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Warrior.
Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

2061-2104-4125.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation each turn.
2061-2104-4125.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser.
When the Shipwreck Dowser token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2316-4365-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
2316-4365-5231.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

2028-2034--6.notablePrerequisites: The undying creature does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
2028-2034--6.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the undying creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Hexavus' second ability by paying {1} and removing the +1/+1 counter from the undying creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hexavus.
Repeat.

Repeat.

1218-3011.notablePrerequisites:
Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
Your opponents have a life total of twenty or greater, minus two for each poison counter they have.

Activate Lair of the Hydra's last ability by paying {1}{G}, making it a 1/1 land creature until end of turn.
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, exchanging the text boxes of Devoted Druid and Lair of the Hydra.
As the turn ends, Lair of the Hydra stops being a creature.
On your opponent's upkeep, activate Lair of the Hydra using Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Lair of the Hydra using Devoted Druid's last ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on it and untapping it.
Repeat from step 5.

You have a nonartifact Minotaur creature card in hand.

Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Minotaur you control.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning any other nontoken, nonartifact Minotaur from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Ayula.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Ayula trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on any creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1329-1414-3152-5202.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1414-3152-5202.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lotus Petal.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Chakram Retriever and Efficient Construction both trigger.
Resolve the Chakram Retriever trigger, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Efficient Construction trigger, creating a 1/1 Thopter token.
Lotus Petal resolves.
Repeat.

628-2034-5296.description:
Activate Workhorse by removing all +1/+1 counters, adding that many {C}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Workhorse, adding {C}{C}.
Workhorse undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
